contract-account.whenFails: If the code hash changed, the contract was upgraded: every claim about the deployed contract needs a second look.

sandwich-account.about: Sandwich Man's account exists on mainnet, holds NEAR for gas, runs no contract code and has exactly one key: the full-access key its creating transaction added.
sandwich-account.whenFails: If the key differs, the owner rotated it: put the new public key here. If the account is gone or out of NEAR, he was retired or needs a top-up: update the README's track table and docs/npc-trader.md.

sandwich-bits.about: Sandwich Man holds something in the contract: his Bits, the items in his wallet and the items he has listed add up to more than zero. This stays true as he spends, because Bits he spends become items he holds or lists.
sandwich-bits.whenFails: If the total is 0 he holds nothing at all: he was drained or retired. Say so in the README's track table and docs/npc-trader.md.

sandwich-wallet.about: Sandwich Man is not a player in the contract: he has no hero and no level, and the operator has minted to him exactly once (the seed).
sandwich-wallet.whenFails: If reward_nonce is over 1, something was minted to him after the seed: the docs' "one-off seed" needs a second look.

loop-on-paper.about: The order the loop was written in: the 2D real-time prototype (699457d, Nov 1), then the 3D plan docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (94c8d19, Nov 2), then the first 3D simulation code (143b12e, its types; 0134541, the simulation). Local: needs this clone's history, no network.

tx-relayed-buy.about: README command E: a market_buy by the player azalleaxyz.wgpnear.near (not the author's account), signed by their session key and sent by the relayer, with no deposit, the fee burned.

tx-open-market.about: The owner's set_market_params, which minted Gwei's stock and till to the contract's own account.

tx-factory-account.about: The factory creating a player's account (9a_z53.wgpnear.near, not the author's) with two keys.

tx-mint-rewards.about: A reward mint from the operator.

tx-craft-suit.about: A player's craft_suit of Stealth, burning the recipe's Sybil goo and minting the suit.

tx-market-buy.about: A market_buy from Gwei, with the fee burned.

tx-list-item.about: A player's list_item: the items move to the contract, in escrow.

tx-buy-listing.about: Another player's buy_listing: Bits go from the buyer to the seller.

no-invest-views.about: The deployed contract has no investing: no market_shops view.
no-invest-views.whenFails: v3 (or later) is deployed: rewrite the investing claims in the README, docs/INVESTING.md and docs/GAME-LOOP.md, and check investing against the real contract.

no-get-version.about: The deployed contract has no get_version, which is how the app reads it as v2 and offers no investing.
no-get-version.whenFails: v3 (or later) is deployed: rewrite the investing claims in the README, docs/INVESTING.md and docs/GAME-LOOP.md, and check investing against the real contract.

tx-npc-create.about: The owner's account, wgpnear.near, created sandwich.wgpnear.near with a transfer and one key (Nov 13, 2026).

tx-npc-seed.about: The one-off seed: the operator's mint_rewards of 300 Bits to Sandwich Man, nonce 1, with the digest sha256("npc-seed:sandwich.wgpnear.near:v1").

tx-npc-first-trade.about: Sandwich Man's first trade: a market_buy of 2 Sybil goo from Gwei for 72 Bits, signed by his own key (not relayed), with no deposit and the fee burned.

tx-contract-topup.about: The Nov 13, 2026 top-up of the contract's storage balance: a transfer from the relayer's account to game.wgpnear.near.

season-s1.about: Season 1's record, in whichever state it is: open (nothing recorded, no results file), closed (the board frozen, the record not landed yet) or recorded (root, digest, board and trophies all matching the results file).
season-s1.whenFails: The record and the site disagree, or something was recorded before the season's end.

v3-branch.about: The branch review/contract-v3 holds the thirteen commits docs/CONTRACT-V3-REVIEW.md names, with v3's source, its review tests, the mainnet rehearsal and the rollback build, and it is not merged into this checkout. Local: needs the branch in this clone; skipped, with a note, in a clone that doesn't have it.
v3-branch.whenFails: If merged is true, v3's source is now on this branch: the README must stop saying it is not on main.

repo-history.about: This clone's history: the date of its first commit, and the commits that carry an AI trailer, read as git trailers (Co-authored-by) and as "Generated with Claude" lines. Local, no network.

site-night-length.about: On the live site, verified play time divided by verified runs (all modes together) stays between 45 seconds and 3 minutes: a night is about a minute and a half, not five.

player-senders.about: Who sent the player transactions the README lists: looked up again, they come from five different accounts, and the author's is not one of them.

site-gas-quote.about: A dry quote from the live Gas tank: 2 USDC on Base into NEAR. The body names another recipient; the answer still names the relayer, and a dry quote has no deposit address, so nothing can be sent.
site-gas-quote.whenFails: A 404 means the feature isn't deployed yet; a 503 intents_not_configured means RELAYER_ACCOUNT_ID or NEAR_NETWORK isn't set on the site; a 502 means 1Click didn't answer.
